changes_made.explanation: Added LLaVA-NeXT model mentioned in the paper. Kept reasoning segmentation as primary task with image captioning as secondary.
Metrics are correctly extracted and normalized. gIoU and cIoU are specific segmentation evaluation metrics used extensively in the paper.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are used for generation (reasoning and region proposal) but not for post-hoc evaluation.
No human evaluations are conducted in this paper. Evaluation is purely based on automatic metrics (gIoU, cIoU, mAP) with qualitative case studies.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on reasoning segmentation (vision-language task) using MLLMs for generation. Correctly uses automatic metrics for evaluation but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluations. Extraction quality is good overall with minor additions needed.
